acceptance.given: A required source is missing or its frozen content has changed during plan compilation or repair.

oracle.expected: The repair path records the source gap and produces an in-scope contract-repair outcome without initiating any prohibited automatic workflow.
oracle.observable: The repair command result and persisted repair decision identify contract repair as the handling path and contain no publication, Bootstrap-loop, lineage-creation, or out-of-scope-patch action.

acceptance.then: Required source changes are handled through contract repair within the declared plan scope.
acceptance.when: Execute the repository VDD repair entry point for the changed-source condition and inspect its structured outcome and bounded side effects.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_core.py::test_a04 (or its repository-supported repair selector) must fail when a changed or missing required source is handled by publication, Bootstrap looping, new-lineage creation, or an out-of-scope patch instead of contract repair.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure changed or missing required sources are routed to bounded contract repair and do not trigger automatic publication, Bootstrap looping, lineage creation, or out-of-scope patching.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert only the repair-routing change; preserve existing plan, source-index, and historical evidence formats.

slice_hint.state_transition: required source missing or changed -> contract repair within current scope; no automatic publication, Bootstrap loop, lineage creation, or out-of-scope patch
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The bounded repair invocation reports an in-scope contract-repair decision and records none of the four prohibited automatic actions.
